C0476.title: Shanghai Family of Five Exploited Virtual Numbers to Scam Mall Parking Credits
C0476.summary: Starting March 2024, Zang and his wife Xiao, along with others, exploited a new member registration loophole at shopping malls by using virtual phone numbers to bulk-register memberships, fraudulently obtaining points and free parking vouchers.
